title: roulette skin (DRAFT, Phase 1)
description: DRAFT for the Phase 3 plugin engine/games/roulette/ (single-zero European roulette, SPEC 3.3), generalised from engine/games/_legacy/lapidary-wheel.math.js. The maths keeps the neutral pocket keys red | black | zero and the standard wheel order and bets; the skin names the pockets, picks theme tokens and sets chips and the table limit. RTP is 36/37 for every bet whatever the skin. Not yet read by any code.
